report:
test_total does not fail. I ran the three tests in test_cart.py: test_plain PASS, test_total PASS, test_half_cent_rounds_up FAIL.

test_total: total([(2,150),(1,99)], discount_percent=10) computes 399 * 0.9 = 359.1, and int() truncates to 359, which matches the expected 359. It passes.

The failing test is test_half_cent_rounds_up: total([(1,1010)], discount_percent=5) computes 1010 * 0.95 = 959.5, and int() truncates toward zero to 959, but the test expects 960 (half cent rounds up).

Cause: cart.total uses int(subtotal * (1 - discount_percent / 100)). int() truncates; it does not round. The docstring says "rounded to whole cents", so the code does not do what it says. test_total only passes because 359.1 truncates and rounds to the same value.

Note: pytest is not installed in this Python (3.14), so I called the test functions directly. I changed nothing in cart.py or test_cart.py.
